title: AI Engineer
description: Join our innovative team at Curamando as an AI Engineer! Work with cutting-edge technologies, mentor others, and help shape the future of our growing AI practice in a collaborative, inclusive environment.At Curamando, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. We empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it.Curamando, part of the Nordic consulting house Eidra, specialises in accelerating top-line growth through digital strategy and innovation. We're a fast-growing consultancy already partnering with industry leaders — from cutting-edge automotive brands to forward-looking tech companies. Together with Eidra's 1,200+ strategists, creatives, and engineers spread across Stockholm, New York, and beyond, we tackle ambitious problems at scale. This role isn't only about delivering on Curamando's value offering — you'll also play an integral part in helping other Eidra verticals deliver on their AI agenda, well beyond commerce.We're looking for people ready to join us on this journey, bringing passion, creativity, and dedication. This role is open across multiple levels — from individual contributors to senior engineers and emerging leaders — and offers an opportunity to develop your craft while working closely with clients on real-world AI challenges.Job Summary:We are seeking AI Engineers with experience in building robust, scalable, AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate combines a product engineering mindset with deep enthusiasm for advancing AI capabilities, a strong interest in knowledge sharing and mentoring, and a genuine curiosity about how to build value offerings on the cutting edge of AI.For more senior candidates, we're particularly interested in people with an intrapreneurial and business development mindset - finding your path in our career framework means being curious about the business tooA passion for innovation and a knack for problem-solvingEagerness to learn, grow, and take on new challengesBelief in collaboration, diversity, and making a significant impactWhat We Offer:A chance to work closely with global brands on diverse projects that push the boundaries of what's possible - across Curamando and the wider Eidra group.A fun and fair work environment where you can expand your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues.A personal coach, and a setting where you can grow professionally and personally.Being part of multidisciplinary teams in a highly ambitious setting.The opportunity to shape how our AI practice evolves and scales.Why Curamando?Career Framework: We believe in fairness and clarity, which is why we've established a transparent career framework to ensure equal pay and equal opportunities for all. We've cultivated an environment that supports an excellent work-life balance and welcomes team members from all walks of life.Innovations and Learning: Technology is always evolving. Our developers work closely with designers, analysts, testers and more — sharing knowledge and growing together.Skills Over Degrees: We're more interested in what you can do than in the diplomas you hold. title: LLM Engineer
description: Work with LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Gemini, and other open-source or commercial models. Develop and optimize prompts to improve model accuracy and response quality. Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and embedding models. Implement NLP techniques for text processing, summarization, classification, and information extraction. Integrate LLMs with applications using APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, or Weaviate. Evaluate model performance, reduce hallucinations, and optimize response latency and cost. Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to build AI-powered solutions. Deploy and monitor LLM applications in cloud environments. Requirements Strong knowledge of Python programming. Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI. Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and prompt engineering. Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks. Understanding of RAG architecture, embeddings, and semantic search. Familiarity with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or Chroma. Knowledge of REST APIs and application integration. Basic understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts. Familiarity with Git and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is an advantage. Show more Show less

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About the Team:We are building the next generation of AI Agentic capabilities for one of our core enterprise products, evolving it from a productivity tool into an intelligent assistant that can understand context, take actions, and get work done autonomously on behalf of our users.We are seeking experienced AI Engineers who are passionate about solving complex technical challenges, whether as a hands-on Individual Contributor or in a Team Lead capacity. As a senior member of the team, you will work as a close technical partner to our Product Manager, shaping the product direction from a technical feasibility standpoint while owning the architecture and delivery of our AI Agent products end to end.Job Description:Lead the technical architecture and end-to-end development of AI Agentic products for a core enterprise platform, partnering closely with the Product Manager to shape product direction from a technical feasibility standpoint.Architect and build scalable agent frameworks (multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, memory, orchestration across multiple LLMs and services) that power our product's copilot and automation features.Own the full lifecycle of AI features — technical design, model selection/fine-tuning, evaluation, production deployment, and monitoring — ensuring reliability, latency, and cost efficiency at scale.Mentor junior AI engineers, set best practices for prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agent evaluation, and help build reusable AI infrastructure for the broader team.Partner cross-functionally with product, design, backend/infra, and security teams to ensure AI features are robust, safe, and compliant with data governance requirements.Stay on top of the latest advances in LLMs and agentic AI, and proactively identify opportunities to apply new techniques to our product roadmap.Requirements:Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.Minimum 5 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered systems in production.Deep expertise in LLM application development: prompt engineering, RAG, agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen), tool/function calling, and multi-agent orchestration.Strong foundation in machine learning/deep learning, with practical experience in model fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization (latency, cost, accuracy trade-offs).Proven track record of shipping AI-powered products end-to-end, from prototype to production, ideally in a B2B/enterprise or SaaS setting.Excellent system design skills, able to architect scalable, secure, and maintainable AI infrastructure.Fast learner with a strong self-driven mindset and a bias for action; comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving technical decisions independently.Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to partner closely with product managers and designers to translate business needs into technical solutions.Experience with enterprise SaaS, productivity platforms, or AI copilot products is a strong plus. title: Jumio: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Fraud)
description: Headquarters: India (remote) Role Purpose: The Machine Learning Engineer IV will play a critical role in advancing Jumio's Fraud team's mission to develop and enhance state-of-the-art solutions for fraud detection for ID verification purposes. This role is essential for ensuring the highest standards of security and user verification through the application of advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques, ultimately contributing to Jumio's leadership in the online identity verification, eKYC, and AML solutions market Role Value: As a Machine Learning Engineer IV at Jumio, you will have the opportunity to significantly impact the security and user experience of our ID verification solutions. Your expertise in deep learning and computer vision will drive the development of innovative algorithms that keep Jumio at the forefront of the industry. By deploying and maintaining these models in production, you will ensure the robustness and reliability of our solutions, supporting our clients across diverse industries such as Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, and Gaming. Your contributions will be pivotal in maintaining Jumio's reputation as the leading provider of online identity verification solutions, helping to meet the growing demand for secure and seamless user verification globally.   Example Responsibilities .  Develop, maintain, and own key fraudulent CV models of Jumio, which shapes the whole fraud product offering of Jumio.  Design and implement machine learning, deep learning, classical CV focused on fraud detection. Research to support the deployment of the advanced algorithms. Deploy models as AWS SageMaker endpoints or directly onto devices. Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision by engaging with academic papers and attending industry conferences. Work collaboratively with other engineers and product managers in an Agile development environment. Experience and Qualifications   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field. A minimum of 6+ years of commercial experience in the field of machine learning/deep learning, not including time spent studying (2 years with Master’s). Must have: experience with training of DL models for deepfakes, synthetic data, or gen AI data detection. Deep understanding of how to convert ML metrics to product goals.  Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, SKLearn, and in developing production-grade Python code. Demonstrated experience in implementing best practices for monitoring and maintaining ML models in production environments. Strong communication and problem-solving skills. Great to have Experience and Qualifications  Experience in working with LLM’s or VLM’s. Work with image or video generation. Experience with cloud environments - AWS / GCP. Experience in working in global organizations across several timezones Jumio Values: IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation Equal Opportunities : Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. About Jumio: Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.  Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others. Applicant Data Privacy We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice.
